title: Joshua's Farewell and Covenant at Shechem

date.label: Undated Joshua farewell and covenant narrative
date.note: Biblical narrative chronology is not independently established as an absolute BCE date.

claims.claim: Joshua 23 juxtaposes fulfilled promises and covenant warnings (Joshua 23:1–16)
Joshua 24 narrates covenant assembly at Shechem (Joshua 24:1–28)
Joshua sets a witness stone under an oak in the sanctuary area (Joshua 24:26–27)
Joshua 24 reports Joseph bones and Eleazar burial notices (Joshua 24:32–33)

connections.note: Covenant choice and sanctions furnish closely related literary theology.
The Shechem oak and the putting away of foreign gods are comparable motifs, but they make no claim about the same stone.
Earlier transport of Joseph’s bones is fulfilled in Joshua 24:32.
Judges 2:6–10 gives an overlapping account of Joshua’s death and the next generation, not a separate death.
Hebrews 11:22 recalls Joseph’s instruction concerning his bones; the thematic link to Joshua 24:32 is later reception, not a prediction by Hebrews.
